calibration.source: vial_fill stills from videos 1-4, read from enlarged gridded crops; collar x set to the median detected collar center (vialcv.locate) on those stills
calibration.notes: Video 5 was not used to set these values; it is reserved for evaluation.

line_notes.backdrop_bottom: Above this the vial is seen against the white backdrop (backlit). Empty-vial edge median y=304 (p5 303, p95 308); liquid lensing moves it to ~312-316.
line_notes.bore_view_top: Below this the liquid is seen inside the bright puck bore (empty-vial lightness rises from y~386).

region_notes.vial: Liquid search area at the fill station: inside the glass walls, from the collar bottom down to the bottom of the visible puck bore.
region_notes.collar: Black vial collar on the carrier; moves with the carrier.
region_notes.puck_bore: Liquid seen through the opening in the top of the aluminum puck; low fills are visible only here.
region_notes.nozzle_stream: Below the nozzle tip and above the vial labels; a dispense stream passes through its middle with backdrop on both sides.
region_notes.collar_face: Dark front face of a carrier collar parked at the station; mostly dark pixels when a carrier is present.
region_notes.station: Carrier, vial, and puck at the station; frame-to-frame change here means a carrier is moving.
region_notes.white_reference: Plain white backdrop left of the station; occluded only while a vial is moved out.
region_notes.timestamp_overlay: Burned-in capture timestamp; never measure here.
region_notes.static_scene: Nozzle and equipment above the station that never move with carriers; used to detect camera shift.
